patch_description: A symmetry-aware, parameter-efficient variational ansatz using alternating controlled rotations (CRX on ring edges and CRY on hub edges) with deliberate parameter sharing across symmetric tile classes (corners, edges, center). The block uses a compact two-stage local rotation (RY then RZ), staggered ring entanglers with two shared parameters to create richer mixing per parameter, and a small shared final RX/RZ mixer tuned for Z-basis readout. This design increases expressive entanglement per parameter, leverages the tic-tac-toe spatial symmetries to reduce overfitting, and aligns entangling axes with the measurement basis to produce sharper class separation faster and with fewer effective degrees of freedom.
